nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating whether to give up return on investment to gain exclusivity, be willing to accept 45-50% cash-on-cash if it triples your pipeline, because volume compounds returns even as per-deal yield drops.

_from i_m_so_confused_walk_me_through_how_you_make_money_fTV3PbWAfWQ.txt_

nodes.label: Remove yourself entirely from day-to-day salon operations before attempting to f…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Remove yourself entirely from day-to-day salon operations before attempting to franchise; the business must run without you so franchisees can replicate it.

_from i_m_trying_to_build_an_empire_hormozi_stops_her_cold_xrZH29ut-LY.txt_

nodes.label: Do not use the word 'coach' to describe your role if your business model is fran…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Do not use the word 'coach' to describe your role if your business model is franchise sales; position yourself as an educator online whose offer converts to a franchise purchase.

_from i_m_trying_to_build_an_empire_hormozi_stops_her_cold_xrZH29ut-LY.txt_

nodes.label: Test whether your brick-and-mortar model is truly proven by stripping out all or…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Test whether your brick-and-mortar model is truly proven by stripping out all organic social media traffic mentally and recalculating margins assuming 10-30% of revenue spent on paid new-client acquisition.

_from i_m_trying_to_build_an_empire_hormozi_stops_her_cold_xrZH29ut-LY.txt_

nodes.label: For a nail salon targeting franchise, increase technician compensation to a poin…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For a nail salon targeting franchise, increase technician compensation to a point where their income trajectory (e.g., path to $100k/year) creates loyalty and reduces churn, because technician retention drives customer retention and allows premium pricing.

_from i_m_trying_to_build_an_empire_hormozi_stops_her_cold_xrZH29ut-LY.txt_

nodes.label: When clients ask for your time outside of agreed delivery sessions, route them t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When clients ask for your time outside of agreed delivery sessions, route them to an available resource (FAQ, document, recording) or to the next scheduled calendar slot rather than answering immediately, to avoid reinforcing the behavior of unscheduled outreach.

_from i_m_trying_to_replicate_gym_launch_in_the_pet_care_industry_pstJXCdpIio.txt_

nodes.label: When announcing a delivery model change to existing clients, enumerate at least …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When announcing a delivery model change to existing clients, enumerate at least several concrete reasons why the new model benefits them — new investments you can make in their outcomes, previously unmet promises you can now fulfill — rather than simply describing what will no longer be provided.

_from i_m_trying_to_replicate_gym_launch_in_the_pet_care_industry_pstJXCdpIio.txt_

nodes.label: Before changing demand-generation activities (content, selling cadence, channels…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before changing demand-generation activities (content, selling cadence, channels), first diagnose whether the business is supply-constrained or demand-constrained; only modify demand-side inputs when a genuine demand constraint exists.

_from i_m_trying_to_replicate_gym_launch_in_the_pet_care_industry_pstJXCdpIio.txt_

nodes.label: When evaluating a side business or investment, ask whether it actively changes w…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating a side business or investment, ask whether it actively changes what you do each day. If it does not change anything about your daily workflow, it is not a distraction. If you find yourself checking it constantly or optimizing it, treat it as a distraction and restructure or exit.

_from i_want_to_grow_my_business_but_i_don_t_want_to_sacrifice_fam_iq4VNdOAfWM.txt_

nodes.label: To preserve growth momentum while protecting family time, identify whether you v…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To preserve growth momentum while protecting family time, identify whether you value short-term profit or short-term family time more, then sacrifice the less-valued one deliberately rather than letting the business drift and sacrificing both by accident.

_from i_want_to_grow_my_business_but_i_don_t_want_to_sacrifice_fam_iq4VNdOAfWM.txt_

nodes.label: Keep passive investments (real estate, REITs, funds) in structures where compete…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Keep passive investments (real estate, REITs, funds) in structures where competent partners manage them without requiring founder involvement. Do not make passive capital active by injecting personal optimization time unless you are prepared to treat it as a full active business.

_from i_want_to_grow_my_business_but_i_don_t_want_to_sacrifice_fam_iq4VNdOAfWM.txt_

nodes.label: List your premium one-on-one price wherever you sell your offers — on your websi…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** List your premium one-on-one price wherever you sell your offers — on your website, in sales conversations, anywhere visible — so prospects can anchor to it even if they never inquire about it.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: When offering a premium tier, explicitly confront the price with the prospect an…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When offering a premium tier, explicitly confront the price with the prospect and then stop talking; silence after stating the price gives the prospect space to say yes, which talking would preempt.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: After a prospect balks at the premium price, pull out a subset of the premium of…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** After a prospect balks at the premium price, pull out a subset of the premium offer's components into a mid-tier that retains roughly 90% of the value at a more accessible price point.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: Use the 10x/100x price thought-experiment: write down everything you would do fo…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Use the 10x/100x price thought-experiment: write down everything you would do for a client if they paid 10x or 100x your current rate, cross out items with hard costs, and then assess whether the remaining zero-marginal-cost elements are worth packaging at a higher price.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: Use the word-of-mouth-only constraint: design an offer as if the only acquisitio…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Use the word-of-mouth-only constraint: design an offer as if the only acquisition channel is referral from one satisfied client, then use that design as the template for your premium tier.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: Map the entire customer experience and identify every action the customer must t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Map the entire customer experience and identify every action the customer must take to achieve their desired outcome; systematically remove friction points one by one to engineer an exceptional high-value product worth its premium price.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: In premium service tiers, emphasize speed and latency reduction — guaranteed pri…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** In premium service tiers, emphasize speed and latency reduction — guaranteed priority, first access to new offers, ability to pull a team member off another job immediately — as these time-savings features are the primary value driver for wealthy buyers.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: Extract customer-review language from books in your niche and use those verbatim…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Extract customer-review language from books in your niche and use those verbatim pain-point phrases in your offer copy to mirror the prospect's own internal vocabulary.

_from if_i_started_a_business_in_2026_i_d_do_this_uWdIgftpvBI.txt_

nodes.label: When building a brand, deliberately curate what you pair your name with: add pai…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When building a brand, deliberately curate what you pair your name with: add pairings your ideal customer associates with positive outcomes (the flowers you want), and actively remove or avoid pairings your ideal customer dislikes (the weeds). Do both; curation requires addition and subtraction.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: When recovering from a bad brand pairing (e.g., a controversy), do not attempt t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When recovering from a bad brand pairing (e.g., a controversy), do not attempt to eliminate or erase the bad pairing — overwhelm it with positive new pairings until the bad one becomes statistically irrelevant to your audience's overall perception.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: When making educational content introductions, lead with whichever of Proof, Pro…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When making educational content introductions, lead with whichever of Proof, Promise, or Plan is most critical for that specific video — proof if the viewer needs credibility to trust you, promise if the value proposition is the key hook, plan if the structure of the session is what keeps people watching.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: Do not make content decisions based on what your team wants to create — your tea…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Do not make content decisions based on what your team wants to create — your team may not be your ideal customer. Periodically test your content against actual target buyers (business owners in person if possible) and weight their feedback above internal team preference.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: Track paired KPIs for content performance rather than single metrics: use views …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Track paired KPIs for content performance rather than single metrics: use views (quantity) paired with RPM (quality) via ad revenue to prevent optimizing for reach at the expense of audience relevance. Apply the same paired-metric logic to other departments: customer service tickets resolved paired with customer satisfaction score; cleaning jobs completed paired with review rating.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: When negotiating an agency engagement for platform-specific content production, …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When negotiating an agency engagement for platform-specific content production, state explicit intentions upfront: commit to a defined term (e.g., six months), ask the agency to explain their decision-making process and the why behind each choice, document their SOPs internally, co-create with them so your team builds expertise, and agree in advance on a transition to a lower-cost consulting arrangement once your in-house team reaches parity.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: When entering an influencer partnership (equity deal), require a portion of equi…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When entering an influencer partnership (equity deal), require a portion of equity upfront regardless of performance to compensate for the permanent brand association transfer you make at the moment of public declaration. Structure remaining equity in performance-based and time-based tranches.

_from if_i_wanted_to_grow_an_audience_in_2026_i_d_do_this_Jmkq5RLjm0U.txt_

nodes.label: Stop eating out entirely; if hungry, deal with it. Buy food only from discount g…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Stop eating out entirely; if hungry, deal with it. Buy food only from discount grocery stores.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: Wear the clothing you currently own for the next two years. No exceptions. Trade…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Wear the clothing you currently own for the next two years. No exceptions. Trade, go to Goodwill, or simply reuse.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: Live with family or with other people also trying to build, at the lowest cost p…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Live with family or with other people also trying to build, at the lowest cost possible. A paid-off clunker is the ideal car situation; if you cannot pay it off, keep the cost as low as humanly possible.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: Block maker time and manager time into separate, non-overlapping periods; keep t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Block maker time and manager time into separate, non-overlapping periods; keep them separated to avoid task switching. Hormozi's personal structure: Mondays are manager days; the rest of the week is maker time.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: When researching a skill, print out your bank or credit card statement and look …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When researching a skill, print out your bank or credit card statement and look at what you actually spend money on — those categories represent things consumers already pay for.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: Apply the 1-1-1 rule: sell one product or service to one avatar on one channel u…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Apply the 1-1-1 rule: sell one product or service to one avatar on one channel until you hit $1 million. Do not diversify before that milestone.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: When allocating learning budget, prioritize tools (software), implementation hel…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When allocating learning budget, prioritize tools (software), implementation help (courses, communities, tutoring), and trial attempts (actual ad spend or channel tests) in that order of setup sequence.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: When evaluating content you consume, ask: what do I do now? If you cannot answer…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating content you consume, ask: what do I do now? If you cannot answer that question, the content is entertainment, not learning.

_from if_i_wanted_to_make_my_first_100k_in_2026_i_d_do_this_jfW6gL6hKhk.txt_

nodes.label: When supply-constrained, ask first whether you can solve the constraint by deliv…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When supply-constrained, ask first whether you can solve the constraint by delivering the same offer to more people at once (changing the ratio) before building an entirely new lower-price product.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Use two in-person getaway events per year (positioned as vacations, not conferen…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Use two in-person getaway events per year (positioned as vacations, not conferences) as both the primary renewal vehicle and the core high-value deliverable of a high-ticket coaching offer.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Eliminate asynchronous messaging access (Slack, DMs) from high-ticket coaching o…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Eliminate asynchronous messaging access (Slack, DMs) from high-ticket coaching offers; redirect community questions to a group setting where answers serve all members simultaneously.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Structure in-person event pitch as: value content sessions, soft repitch on day …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Structure in-person event pitch as: value content sessions, soft repitch on day two morning (teaching while overcoming objections), then a 15-minute stack-and-close, followed by a dinner invitation exclusively for buyers to create immediate social reward.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Increase organic social posting to at least one piece of content per day before …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Increase organic social posting to at least one piece of content per day before scaling paid advertising; use organic performance data to identify winning creative before committing ad budget.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Run 100 or more static image variations from a camera roll for paid social ads r…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Run 100 or more static image variations from a camera roll for paid social ads rather than relying on a small set of produced images or inconsistent video.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: When pitching a high-ticket offer, present the down payment amount (e.g., one qu…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When pitching a high-ticket offer, present the down payment amount (e.g., one quarter of the annual contract value) as the primary financial commitment the prospect is making, not the total contract value.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Frame the transition from 1:1 to 1:4 group delivery to existing clients as a pro…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Frame the transition from 1:1 to 1:4 group delivery to existing clients as a product improvement rather than an apology; explain the specific mechanism by which group format benefits them (hearing others' questions, learning from peers' problems ahead of time).

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: At in-person events, assign staff to small rosters of attendees (color-coded lan…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** At in-person events, assign staff to small rosters of attendees (color-coded lanyards), equip each staff member with two personalized facts about each attendee, and require those facts to be used in introductions to signal operational attentiveness.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Offer a rebate (e.g., $2,500 off on a $27,500 offer) in exchange for a client-fi…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Offer a rebate (e.g., $2,500 off on a $27,500 offer) in exchange for a client-filmed video testimonial of their experience; specify that videos should cover only the experience and feelings, not financial terms.

_from if_i_wanted_to_scale_a_service_business_in_2026_here_s_what_N5MExtki_VI.txt_

nodes.label: Test counterintuitive hypotheses in product, pricing, and delivery design becaus…
nodes.plugin: Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Test counterintuitive hypotheses in product, pricing, and delivery design because your competitors will not; the asymmetry of competitive testing means the gains from counterintuitive discoveries are uncontested.

_from innovation_and_beyond_with_rory_sutherland_8RVXVt1LZAw.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver
nodes.topic: Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver

nodes.label: When a product is not selling, try raising the price before concluding there is …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a product is not selling, try raising the price before concluding there is a demand problem; price can function as a quality and efficacy signal that actually increases willingness to buy.

_from innovation_and_beyond_with_rory_sutherland_8RVXVt1LZAw.txt_

nodes.label: Do not drop prices to increase perceived value; instead change the payment mode …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Do not drop prices to increase perceived value; instead change the payment mode (e.g., introduce contactless payment) to reduce the pain-of-paying, which increases perceived value without reducing margin.

_from innovation_and_beyond_with_rory_sutherland_8RVXVt1LZAw.txt_

nodes.label: When a home visit or delivery service cannot guarantee a narrow window, tell cus…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a home visit or delivery service cannot guarantee a narrow window, tell customers you will text an hour before arrival rather than booking a precise slot; this delivers 90% of the customer satisfaction benefit of a one-hour window at roughly 1% of the logistical cost.

_from innovation_and_beyond_with_rory_sutherland_8RVXVt1LZAw.txt_

nodes.label: To improve recruitment diversity, hire people in cohort groups rather than one a…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To improve recruitment diversity, hire people in cohort groups rather than one at a time; the brain's variety-seeking mode activates in simultaneous group selection and its conformity mode activates in sequential single selections.

_from innovation_and_beyond_with_rory_sutherland_8RVXVt1LZAw.txt_

nodes.label: To dominate shelf space in physical retail, produce multiple variants to take a …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To dominate shelf space in physical retail, produce multiple variants to take a larger facing; perceived mainstream status scales with shelf prominence, not product quality.

_from innovation_and_beyond_with_rory_sutherland_8RVXVt1LZAw.txt_

nodes.label: Before switching your business model due to a market shift, first identify two o…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before switching your business model due to a market shift, first identify two or three intermediate fixes: find customers in the same category who still have coverage, test a sales process improvement to close cash-pay customers, and test a back-end membership upsell on existing emergency customers. Only declare the model broken if all three fail.

_from insurance_stopped_paying_should_i_switch_to_a_membership_mod_r7AzdHfBu68.txt_

nodes.label: After completing an emergency service job, attempt to sell a recurring preventio…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** After completing an emergency service job, attempt to sell a recurring prevention membership to the customer before leaving the site; use the post-resolution trust and the customer's fresh memory of the damage as the pitch foundation.

_from insurance_stopped_paying_should_i_switch_to_a_membership_mod_r7AzdHfBu68.txt_

nodes.label: For property damage restoration businesses with partial insurance coverage, stru…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For property damage restoration businesses with partial insurance coverage, structure pricing so that cash payment upfront covers cost of acquisition and direct costs, then pursue insurance reimbursement to capture the profit margin on the back end.

_from insurance_stopped_paying_should_i_switch_to_a_membership_mod_r7AzdHfBu68.txt_

nodes.label: Try to be good at two things that are perhaps interconnected.
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Try to be good at two things that are perhaps interconnected.

_from introduction_london_australia_marketingpsychology_Npx9YFUZ6-A.txt_

nodes.label: Do not try to be passionate about what you do; try to be passionate about why an…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Do not try to be passionate about what you do; try to be passionate about why and how you do it, because your why and your how will persist through difficulty while your what is external and subject to change.

_from it_took_me_36_years_to_realize_what_i_ll_tell_you_in_26_minu__KlZoPxbStk.txt_

nodes.label: When evaluating a worst-case scenario, think it through in specific detail rathe…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating a worst-case scenario, think it through in specific detail rather than leaving it vague. Specificity reduces the emotional magnitude of the fear and often reveals the scenario is survivable.

_from it_took_me_36_years_to_realize_what_i_ll_tell_you_in_26_minu__KlZoPxbStk.txt_

nodes.label: Find something people value, do that thing even though it is hard, and accept th…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Find something people value, do that thing even though it is hard, and accept that there is no path without suffering. Select the path that pays better in terms of meaning or reward rather than waiting for a passion-preconditioned path.

_from it_took_me_36_years_to_realize_what_i_ll_tell_you_in_26_minu__KlZoPxbStk.txt_

nodes.label: For sustaining high-pain effort, connect the goal explicitly to people you love …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For sustaining high-pain effort, connect the goal explicitly to people you love and to purposes larger than yourself rather than framing the effort as personal ambition.

_from it_took_me_36_years_to_realize_what_i_ll_tell_you_in_26_minu__KlZoPxbStk.txt_

nodes.label: Make duty and commitment to others cool again; frame working hard for your famil…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Make duty and commitment to others cool again; frame working hard for your family or community as its own source of meaning rather than requiring personal enjoyment of the work itself.

_from it_took_me_36_years_to_realize_what_i_ll_tell_you_in_26_minu__KlZoPxbStk.txt_

nodes.label: Let underperforming customer segments die by attrition rather than explicitly te…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Let underperforming customer segments die by attrition rather than explicitly terminating them; stop actively acquiring them and allow existing contracts to wind down naturally.

_from kill_the_customer_that_s_making_you_money_MKz81j4FsSM.txt_

nodes.label: When evaluating whether to add a second service line or customer avatar, ask: ha…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating whether to add a second service line or customer avatar, ask: have I fully saturated the addressable market for my primary segment? If not, defer the decision.

_from kill_the_customer_that_s_making_you_money_MKz81j4FsSM.txt_

nodes.label: Focus operational improvement efforts (process, efficiency, pricing) exclusively…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Focus operational improvement efforts (process, efficiency, pricing) exclusively on the highest LTV:CAC segment to compound its economics rather than splitting attention across segments with different unit economics.

_from kill_the_customer_that_s_making_you_money_MKz81j4FsSM.txt_

nodes.label: When a competitor copies your existing model, do not react by cutting prices or …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a competitor copies your existing model, do not react by cutting prices or restructuring your offer to match them. Instead, focus on the customer and let the competitor discover on their own whether their model is profitable.

_from let_my_competitor_copy_the_broke_model_pHBSA4udH8Q.txt_

nodes.label: Before building a sales motion, evaluate both product format options (e.g., sing…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before building a sales motion, evaluate both product format options (e.g., single-day vs. multi-day events) by fully loading the unit economics — cost of media team, founder time, and operational setup — to identify which format has the superior return on human and financial capital.

_from let_my_competitor_copy_the_broke_model_pHBSA4udH8Q.txt_

nodes.label: Raise prices continuously until conversion rate signals you have hit the willing…
nodes.plugin: Close Rate as Pricing Calibration Signal
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Raise prices continuously until conversion rate signals you have hit the willingness-to-pay ceiling, then hold there. Do not set price based on the founder's personal financial background or desire to make the product accessible to people who cannot afford it.

_from let_my_competitor_copy_the_broke_model_pHBSA4udH8Q.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Close Rate as Pricing Calibration Signal
nodes.topic: Close Rate as Pricing Calibration Signal

nodes.label: Serve people who cannot afford your paid offer via free content. Serve people wh…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Serve people who cannot afford your paid offer via free content. Serve people who can afford it at the correct price. Do not conflate these two audiences by underpricing paid access.

_from let_my_competitor_copy_the_broke_model_pHBSA4udH8Q.txt_

nodes.label: When structuring a DSO consolidation, agree on and document the exit threshold (…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When structuring a DSO consolidation, agree on and document the exit threshold (the minimum sale price or multiple above which the drag-along rights activate) with all participating practice owners before any acquisition closes.

_from make_an_offer_so_good_they_feel_stupid_saying_no_lpA7Uhav8qA.txt_

nodes.label: In a coaching-to-consolidation model, structure the coaching business as a legal…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** In a coaching-to-consolidation model, structure the coaching business as a legally separate entity from the practice group early so that its IP and licensing terms are cleanly separable at the time of the DSO sale.

_from make_an_offer_so_good_they_feel_stupid_saying_no_lpA7Uhav8qA.txt_

nodes.description:

**Practice:** In legal, medical, or policy contexts, always frame probability questions as comparisons between two competing hypotheses (Bayesian framing) rather than computing P(evidence | innocence) in isolation and treating the complement as P(guilt).

nodes.label: When designing a product, seat, policy, or service for a heterogeneous populatio…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When designing a product, seat, policy, or service for a heterogeneous population, replace a fixed-average design with an adjustable or personalized design, because a design optimized for the average satisfies nobody when the population varies across multiple independent dimensions.

_from the_big_data_dilemma_misleading_correlations_hidden_variable_i9ZjJ26sshU.txt_

nodes.label: Before evaluating a risk or investment decision using expected value, determine …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before evaluating a risk or investment decision using expected value, determine whether the decision will be made once (ensemble average is relevant) or repeatedly by the same individual (time-series path dependency is relevant); only the latter requires ergodicity-adjusted analysis.

_from the_big_data_dilemma_misleading_correlations_hidden_variable_i9ZjJ26sshU.txt_

nodes.label: When diagnosing a service quality problem, segment the affected population by se…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When diagnosing a service quality problem, segment the affected population by severity of impact rather than reporting only aggregate measures; identify the small subset experiencing the extreme end of the distribution and solve for them first, as this often resolves the majority of net dissatisfaction.

_from the_big_data_dilemma_misleading_correlations_hidden_variable_i9ZjJ26sshU.txt_

nodes.label: When designing product attributes (taste, texture, appearance), consider whether…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When designing product attributes (taste, texture, appearance), consider whether sensory signals will reinforce or contradict the positioning claim; mismatched signals reduce belief in the product benefit.

_from the_biggest_marketing_secret_big_companies_don_t_want_you_to_bITH_13xwlg.txt_

nodes.label: When a service business is supply constrained and unwilling to raise prices, hir…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a service business is supply constrained and unwilling to raise prices, hire the next person using available cash flow rather than waiting for a perfect moment or external funding.

_from the_cobbler_s_shoes_problem_killing_your_agency_growth_-G08--_mZaU.txt_

nodes.label: Bake a 30% performance decay into your financial model before handing any functi…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Bake a 30% performance decay into your financial model before handing any function from the founder to a new hire, so the transition is planned and does not destroy profitability.

_from the_cobbler_s_shoes_problem_killing_your_agency_growth_-G08--_mZaU.txt_

nodes.label: Dial the founder's personal involvement in any function toward zero before attem…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Dial the founder's personal involvement in any function toward zero before attempting to scale that function; if the founder remains involved at any percentage, identify and eliminate that dependency first.

_from the_cobbler_s_shoes_problem_killing_your_agency_growth_-G08--_mZaU.txt_

nodes.label: For service businesses, direct end-of-year profit into either A-player talent or…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For service businesses, direct end-of-year profit into either A-player talent or brand plays rather than general overhead or physical capital, because those are the two inputs that generate disproportionate returns in low capex models.

_from the_cobbler_s_shoes_problem_killing_your_agency_growth_-G08--_mZaU.txt_

nodes.label: If your business is at national scale and growing slowly, audit your marketing b…
nodes.plugin: Scaling Performance Marketing Compresses Margins Until Breakeven
nodes.description:
**Practice:** If your business is at national scale and growing slowly, audit your marketing budget split; if you are spending more than 70% on performance / direct response, shift toward brand investments to escape the direct response doom loop.

_from the_cobbler_s_shoes_problem_killing_your_agency_growth_-G08--_mZaU.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Scaling Performance Marketing Compresses Margins Until Breakeven
nodes.topic: Scaling Performance Marketing Compresses Margins Until Breakeven

nodes.label: When evaluating a genuinely new product or technology, do not use aggregate curr…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating a genuinely new product or technology, do not use aggregate current sales as the primary success metric. Instead, measure the rate at which adopters permanently switch and never revert. Near-zero reversion combined with low current adoption is a stronger buy signal than high current sales with high churn.

_from the_craft_of_taking_risks_lHsWv_OzrLg.txt_

nodes.label: When designing organizational incentive systems, include explicit rewards for in…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When designing organizational incentive systems, include explicit rewards for information sharing across the organization, not only for individual output metrics. A salesperson who discovers a better sales approach and shares it with the team should be rewarded for that contribution, not disadvantaged by having competitors inside the firm benefit from their insight.

_from the_craft_of_taking_risks_lHsWv_OzrLg.txt_

nodes.label: When making strategic decisions about where to invest marketing budget, extend t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When making strategic decisions about where to invest marketing budget, extend the attribution window beyond 30-60 days to capture brand effects that operate on 6-12 month horizons. Decisions made solely on short-window attribution systematically under-invest in brand and over-invest in bottom-of-funnel performance marketing.

_from the_craft_of_taking_risks_lHsWv_OzrLg.txt_

nodes.label: In any market analysis, look for outliers and anomalies rather than focusing on …
nodes.plugin: Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver
nodes.description:
**Practice:** In any market analysis, look for outliers and anomalies rather than focusing on the average. The average customer seldom exists and the average conceals where the real opportunity lies. Investigate anything that deviates sharply from the expected pattern before dismissing it as noise.

_from the_craft_of_taking_risks_lHsWv_OzrLg.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver
nodes.topic: Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver

nodes.label: When facing a bet or investment with favorable expected value but with asymmetri…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When facing a bet or investment with favorable expected value but with asymmetric individual career consequences, seek structures that pool risk across multiple stakeholders rather than bearing it individually. The ergodic solution to an individually ruinous but collectively profitable bet is to form a consortium and agree to share outcomes in advance.

_from the_craft_of_taking_risks_lHsWv_OzrLg.txt_

nodes.label: Instead of forward-planning a fixed career path, recognize that unpredictable ch…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Instead of forward-planning a fixed career path, recognize that unpredictable change in job roles and titles means adaptability and breadth of experience are more valuable than specialization early in your career.

_from the_danger_with_career_cpSWMTXfa0g.txt_

nodes.label: When introducing any innovation, expect and plan for adoption resistance even wh…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When introducing any innovation, expect and plan for adoption resistance even when the innovation is objectively superior; view the selling/marketing work as the binding constraint, not product quality.

_from the_future_already_exists_MzU0P96ojTA.txt_

nodes.label: Create a separate budget and separate organizational space for exploratory (20%)…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Create a separate budget and separate organizational space for exploratory (20%) activity with a far higher tolerance of failure than the standard optimization (80%) budget; evaluate exploratory bets on overall probabilistic gains, not individual success rates.

_from the_illusion_of_choice_are_we_really_free_to_choose_rory_sut_tXeHouaerEM.txt_

nodes.label: Test counterintuitive hypotheses specifically because competitors will not; all …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Test counterintuitive hypotheses specifically because competitors will not; all other businesses are testing economically orthodox ideas, so testing the same class of hypotheses produces no information advantage.

_from the_illusion_of_choice_are_we_really_free_to_choose_rory_sut_tXeHouaerEM.txt_

nodes.label: When a product is not selling, raise the price before lowering it; low price can…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a product is not selling, raise the price before lowering it; low price can itself be the barrier to purchase by signaling defect or low social status, and a price increase can be reversed if it fails.

_from the_illusion_of_choice_are_we_really_free_to_choose_rory_sut_tXeHouaerEM.txt_

nodes.label: Never present unqualified bad news; always embed a piece of positive information…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Never present unqualified bad news; always embed a piece of positive information alongside negative news to give the recipient the material with which to construct a positive frame (the fox-and-grapes reframe).

_from the_illusion_of_choice_are_we_really_free_to_choose_rory_sut_tXeHouaerEM.txt_

nodes.label: When measuring advertising and marketing ROI, include post-purchase investments …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When measuring advertising and marketing ROI, include post-purchase investments in continuation probability signaling (packaging, follow-up communications, discretionary extras) rather than only pre-purchase and point-of-purchase spend.

_from the_illusion_of_choice_are_we_really_free_to_choose_rory_sut_tXeHouaerEM.txt_

nodes.label: Before starting client outreach, choose a single niche with: (1) proof of concep…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before starting client outreach, choose a single niche with: (1) proof of concept from other agencies, (2) total addressable market above 10,000 businesses, (3) high-ticket recurring pricing, and (4) a growing market. Use Claude with the niche research rubric prompt to evaluate candidates quickly.

_from the_lazy_way_i_make_money_with_ai_2026.txt_

nodes.label: When running Facebook lead-generation ads for an AI agency serving gym owners, e…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When running Facebook lead-generation ads for an AI agency serving gym owners, exclude Quebec (French-language advertising required by law), target ages 27-65+, use both genders, set language to English, and use Advantage Plus placements to let Facebook optimize placement across Feed, Instagram, Stories, etc.

_from the_lazy_way_i_make_money_with_ai_2026.txt_

nodes.label: When building an AI reviews and referrals system, ask customers to rate their ex…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When building an AI reviews and referrals system, ask customers to rate their experience on a scale of 1-5 first; only ask 4-5 raters for a Google review; send 1-3 raters to a private feedback form; do not tie the raffle incentive directly to leaving a positive review in order to stay compliant with platform policies.

_from the_lazy_way_i_make_money_with_ai_2026.txt_

nodes.label: Target franchise gym owners who own multiple locations or sit on advisory boards…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Target franchise gym owners who own multiple locations or sit on advisory boards as the first anchor client; over-deliver for them before expecting referrals; franchise networks share advisory boards and private owner groups where word travels fast.

_from the_lazy_way_i_make_money_with_ai_2026.txt_

nodes.label: Use AI tools (ChatGPT or Claude) to generate ad copy variations, headlines, and …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Use AI tools (ChatGPT or Claude) to generate ad copy variations, headlines, and creative concepts for client-acquisition ads; the same AI tools being sold to clients can be used to build the agency's own marketing.

_from the_lazy_way_i_make_money_with_ai_2026.txt_

nodes.label: Reframe difficulty on your path from a warning sign that says 'stop or pivot' to…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Reframe difficulty on your path from a warning sign that says 'stop or pivot' to a competitive selection filter that says 'no one else will follow' — the harder the path, the fewer competitors will survive it.

_from the_lonely_chapter_xyKwap1p3rU.txt_

nodes.label: Protect your passion at all costs during the early low-reward phase by celebrati…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Protect your passion at all costs during the early low-reward phase by celebrating milestones, building with people who care about you, rewarding yourself, and not focusing exclusively on lagging outcome metrics.

_from the_lonely_chapter_xyKwap1p3rU.txt_

nodes.label: Future-cast the story you will someday tell about the hard period you are curren…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Future-cast the story you will someday tell about the hard period you are currently in; use that future narrative as a real-time motivational anchor during the lowest-reward stages.

_from the_lonely_chapter_xyKwap1p3rU.txt_

nodes.label: During early-stage content creation or business building, document the journey i…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** During early-stage content creation or business building, document the journey in real time even when there is no audience — the archive has future value to viewers who discover you after your breakout.

_from the_lonely_chapter_xyKwap1p3rU.txt_

nodes.label: Win in the weeds: personally execute the low-level foundational work rather than…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Win in the weeds: personally execute the low-level foundational work rather than delegating or skipping it, because deep context on fundamentals creates downstream competitive advantages that cannot be acquired any other way.

_from the_lonely_chapter_xyKwap1p3rU.txt_

nodes.label: Before considering lowering price when close rate is below 30%, fix avatar targe…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before considering lowering price when close rate is below 30%, fix avatar targeting and sales motion first; price reduction is rarely the correct lever when close rates are very low.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: When setting prepayment billing dates for employed (salaried) customers, ask whe…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When setting prepayment billing dates for employed (salaried) customers, ask when they get paid and align payment dates to those days; for business-owner customers, ask when their cash flow is highest in the month and schedule accordingly.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: When a customer negotiates payment terms, offer layaway framing: they begin payi…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a customer negotiates payment terms, offer layaway framing: they begin paying now and take delivery when payment is complete, aligning their incentive to pay quickly with the business incentive to receive cash early.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: Always ask for a shorter payment window even when longer installment plans are a…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Always ask for a shorter payment window even when longer installment plans are agreed upon; split a 6- or 12-month service into two or three payments within the first 30-60 days rather than spreading across the service duration.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: Implement the Rule of 100 when entering any new acquisition channel: commit to 1…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Implement the Rule of 100 when entering any new acquisition channel: commit to 100 deliberate outreach or advertising actions per day for 100 consecutive days before evaluating channel viability.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: Track the original cohort of customers separately from total customer count when…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Track the original cohort of customers separately from total customer count when measuring annual retention; growth in total customers masks churn in the original cohort and overstates retention.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: Avoid using industry average margins as performance benchmarks; instead, identif…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Avoid using industry average margins as performance benchmarks; instead, identify the physics-based ceiling and optimize toward it.

_from the_mathematics_of_business_explained_A_tx40lNpf8.txt_

nodes.label: To fight the dominance of neoclassical economic models in business, marketers sh…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To fight the dominance of neoclassical economic models in business, marketers should adopt vocabulary from game theory, behavioural economics, and complexity theory (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, endowment effect, commitment bias, sunk cost bias) so they can engage finance directors and CEOs in their own analytical language.

_from the_mind_bending_world_of_marketing_2012_secret_archives_ror_cSf-qlQ_iqM.txt_

nodes.label: When designing a pricing page, place a high-priced anchor option alongside the t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When designing a pricing page, place a high-priced anchor option alongside the target offer to reframe the target price as modest; test the incremental revenue impact before committing.

_from the_mind_bending_world_of_marketing_2012_secret_archives_ror_cSf-qlQ_iqM.txt_

nodes.label: When promoting a volume increase, prefer framing the promotion as a bonus quanti…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When promoting a volume increase, prefer framing the promotion as a bonus quantity (e.g., 50% extra free) rather than a price reduction (e.g., 33% off), since both are economically equivalent but the quantity bonus avoids signalling that the product cannot be sold at full price.

_from the_mind_bending_world_of_marketing_2012_secret_archives_ror_cSf-qlQ_iqM.txt_

nodes.label: When selling rail tickets or other time-sensitive services, find ways to capture…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When selling rail tickets or other time-sensitive services, find ways to capture purchase decisions at earlier points in the customer journey (e.g., out-of-station kiosks in shopping centres) when preference for the service is highest and the inconveniences of travel are psychologically most distant.

_from the_mind_bending_world_of_marketing_2012_secret_archives_ror_cSf-qlQ_iqM.txt_

nodes.label: Marketers should treat marketing as a science drawing on complexity theory, netw…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Marketers should treat marketing as a science drawing on complexity theory, network theory, behavioural economics, and Darwinian psychology, and should develop theories of human behaviour against which data is tested — rather than treating large datasets as self-interpreting.

_from the_mind_bending_world_of_marketing_2012_secret_archives_ror_cSf-qlQ_iqM.txt_

nodes.label: Recognize that mathematical models in school science and MBA economics are teach…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Recognize that mathematical models in school science and MBA economics are teaching an appearance of rationality rather than actual rationality; scrutinize models for whether they truly capture the complexity of the problem or merely create false certainty.

_from the_myth_of_objective_scientist_science_humanities_psycholog_arkUV7d0We4.txt_

nodes.label: Review your calendar weekly, identify every customer meeting or call, attach a t…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Review your calendar weekly, identify every customer meeting or call, attach a transcription plugin to each, and ask AI to surface the most instructive or interesting moments for content repurposing.

_from the_new_way_of_making_content_in_the_age_of_ai_XsWSvz-aewA.txt_

nodes.label: Engineer at least one component of your existing product or service delivery tha…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Engineer at least one component of your existing product or service delivery that generates visible, documentable proof of value; treat this engineered loop as a business design requirement, not an optional marketing add-on.

_from the_new_way_of_making_content_in_the_age_of_ai_XsWSvz-aewA.txt_

nodes.label: For B2B creators with few customers, conduct free public audits of prospects or …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For B2B creators with few customers, conduct free public audits of prospects or non-customers, document them fully, and publish the documentation as the primary proof asset.

_from the_new_way_of_making_content_in_the_age_of_ai_XsWSvz-aewA.txt_

nodes.label: State major accomplishments (revenue, exits, follower count) once at the beginni…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** State major accomplishments (revenue, exits, follower count) once at the beginning of content to establish baseline credibility, then shift immediately to live demonstration rather than repeating the credentials.

_from the_new_way_of_making_content_in_the_age_of_ai_XsWSvz-aewA.txt_

nodes.label: Prioritize creating content formats where your expertise is visibly applied in r…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Prioritize creating content formats where your expertise is visibly applied in real time (live calls, audits, Q&As) over formats where you speak about your expertise abstractly.

_from the_new_way_of_making_content_in_the_age_of_ai_XsWSvz-aewA.txt_

nodes.label: Rory Sutherland recommends that creative practitioners hold the opposite of prev…
nodes.plugin: Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Rory Sutherland recommends that creative practitioners hold the opposite of prevailing assumptions experimentally for roughly half an hour per day and observe where it leads, as a discipline for discovering contrarian value.

nodes.parent_id: concept:Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver
nodes.topic: Contrarian Conviction as Outsized Return Driver

nodes.label: Rory Sutherland recommends that in experience design and website design, the ver…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Rory Sutherland recommends that in experience design and website design, the very beginning of an experience should receive disproportionate investment because it sets the emotional prior that conditions all subsequent judgments.

_from the_objectivity_trap_rory_sutherland_eoG4hCpTLp4.txt_

nodes.label: Rory Sutherland (speaking as VP of Ogilvy) proposes that creative firms require …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Rory Sutherland (speaking as VP of Ogilvy) proposes that creative firms require that 50% of job applicants have never been skiing, as a simple proxy question for non-privileged background, enabling diversity of intake without complex screening systems.

_from the_objectivity_trap_rory_sutherland_eoG4hCpTLp4.txt_

nodes.label: For any recurring service, test multiple framings of the same discount — percent…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For any recurring service, test multiple framings of the same discount — percentage off, absolute dollar reduction, or net first-month price — to identify which headline produces the highest conversion rate.

_from the_offer_structure_a_stranger_pitched_me_in_a_parking_lot_GMiOc8RKYEo.txt_

nodes.label: When designing a one-time fee, select a fee name that clearly describes what you…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When designing a one-time fee, select a fee name that clearly describes what you are doing for the customer, state a plausible reason, and pick a price; then decide whether to charge it, discount it, or waive it on a per-prospect basis depending on sales context.

_from the_offer_structure_a_stranger_pitched_me_in_a_parking_lot_GMiOc8RKYEo.txt_

nodes.label: For services requiring active customer participation (physical therapy, behavior…
nodes.plugin: Setup Fee as Churn Reduction Mechanism
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For services requiring active customer participation (physical therapy, behavior-change programs), charge a meaningful one-time setup fee to increase customer investment and improve follow-through on the actions required to achieve results.

_from the_offer_structure_a_stranger_pitched_me_in_a_parking_lot_GMiOc8RKYEo.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Setup Fee as Churn Reduction Mechanism
nodes.topic: Setup Fee as Churn Reduction Mechanism

nodes.description:
**Practice:** Never reduce a stated price in real time in response to a prospect's resistance; instead, pre-structure all discounts before the conversation and present them as seller-controlled terms with a defined reason and expiry.

_from the_offer_structure_a_stranger_pitched_me_in_a_parking_lot_GMiOc8RKYEo.txt_

nodes.label: Consult legal counsel regarding advertising compliance requirements for discount…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Consult legal counsel regarding advertising compliance requirements for discount-plus-fee structures in your specific jurisdiction before deploying this offer structure.

_from the_offer_structure_a_stranger_pitched_me_in_a_parking_lot_GMiOc8RKYEo.txt_

nodes.label: When selecting music for brand advertising, prioritize familiarity and emotional…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When selecting music for brand advertising, prioritize familiarity and emotional resonance with the target audience over creative originality or signaling to industry peers — apply the P.J. O'Rourke rule: play the music the audience listened to at school or university.

_from the_power_of_ideas_in_marketing_an_interview_with_rory_suthe_WskDKQQ6osY.txt_

nodes.label: Invest in developing a distinctive sonic identity (jingle, musical signature, or…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Invest in developing a distinctive sonic identity (jingle, musical signature, or brand sound) as a brand asset with compounding recognition value — treat it on a par with visual and verbal brand properties.

_from the_power_of_ideas_in_marketing_an_interview_with_rory_suthe_WskDKQQ6osY.txt_

nodes.label: When evaluating product or service improvements, first identify whether the metr…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating product or service improvements, first identify whether the metric being optimized is an engineer-preferred physical metric or a consumer-experience metric; reframe the investment case around the latter before committing capital.

_from the_power_of_ideas_in_marketing_an_interview_with_rory_suthe_WskDKQQ6osY.txt_

nodes.label: Before discounting, carefully evaluate whether the occasion or context justifies…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before discounting, carefully evaluate whether the occasion or context justifies premium pricing, rather than defaulting to price reduction as the first response to sales resistance.

_from the_power_of_perception_how_customers_define_value_behaviour_VDWfjXMMDAM.txt_

nodes.label: Add pricing tiers one at a time, not all at once; build the operational capabili…
nodes.plugin: Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5-10x Gaps
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Add pricing tiers one at a time, not all at once; build the operational capability at each tier before launching the next.

_from the_pricing_rule_that_5x_d_my_profit_overnight_yBrRSS3Vsxk.txt_
nodes.topic: Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5-10x Gaps

nodes.label: Start building your pricing ladder from the highest tier you can operationally d…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Start building your pricing ladder from the highest tier you can operationally deliver, then expand downward toward the base tier.

_from the_pricing_rule_that_5x_d_my_profit_overnight_yBrRSS3Vsxk.txt_

nodes.label: When evaluating whether to create a new upsell tier, verify that it will at leas…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When evaluating whether to create a new upsell tier, verify that it will at least double your existing revenue; if not, the operational complexity is not worth adding.

_from the_pricing_rule_that_5x_d_my_profit_overnight_yBrRSS3Vsxk.txt_

nodes.label: Identify the patterns forming in your industry before they become mainstream, an…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Identify the patterns forming in your industry before they become mainstream, and deliberately move your career toward those emerging patterns rather than optimizing within your current domain.

_from the_psycho_logic_of_the_scroll_why_tiktok_actually_works_WgalrA92K8I.txt_

nodes.label: Seek to build cross-disciplinary fluency between creative and media disciplines;…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Seek to build cross-disciplinary fluency between creative and media disciplines; the overlap between creativity and commercial rigor is small but disproportionately valuable for career differentiation.

_from the_psycho_logic_of_the_scroll_why_tiktok_actually_works_WgalrA92K8I.txt_

nodes.label: Design the choice architecture (the default, the framing of alternatives) before…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Design the choice architecture (the default, the framing of alternatives) before designing the product or the marketing copy; get the last mile of the purchase process right first, then work outward.

_from the_rational_aspects_of_decision_making_3Iv9KqhLTGY.txt_

nodes.label: When diagnosing whether a business problem is a product problem or a perception …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When diagnosing whether a business problem is a product problem or a perception problem, measure consumer perception before investing in product improvement — closing the perception gap may deliver higher ROI than closing the reality gap.

_from the_rational_aspects_of_decision_making_3Iv9KqhLTGY.txt_

nodes.label: When telling employees or customers about a delay or wait time, always give a sp…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When telling employees or customers about a delay or wait time, always give a specific time estimate, even a made-up one; never display 'delayed' without a duration, as indefinite uncertainty is more aversive than a longer certain wait.

_from the_rational_aspects_of_decision_making_3Iv9KqhLTGY.txt_

nodes.label: To overcome defensive decision-making in a team, explicitly authorise the non-de…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To overcome defensive decision-making in a team, explicitly authorise the non-default choice on behalf of the decision-maker, so that if the brave option fails, the accountability sits with the institution rather than the individual.

_from the_rational_aspects_of_decision_making_3Iv9KqhLTGY.txt_

nodes.label: Apply the 'paving the cow paths' principle: observe where users naturally go in …
nodes.description:

nodes.label: When diagnosing why an employee is not executing, work through the Management Di…
nodes.plugin: The Execution Gap: Knowledge Without Action
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When diagnosing why an employee is not executing, work through the Management Diamond in order: (1) Did they know it was required? (2) Did they know how? (3) Did they know the deadline? (4) Is something blocking them? (5) Did they not want to do it? Do not jump to reason 5 — it is the least common true cause.

**Practice:** Ask a hesitant founder-CEO: what is your objective as a CEO, and would your brand be stronger if your business were bigger? Use their answer to reframe outbound DM services as brand-building, not brand-risking.

**Practice:** Translate every standard you hold for your team into a specific, observable action — not a value or feeling, but a behavior you can see and measure.

nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before requiring any behavior of your team, audit whether you personally model that behavior; if you do not, make the change in yourself first.

_from why_most_businesses_fail_no_standards_8N8_Jgx97jA.txt_

nodes.description:
**Practice:** Build a universal membership enrollment motion so that every patient leaving a med spa visit is presented with a membership option; aim for a very high percentage of patients converting to membership to lock in scheduling predictability and recurring revenue.

nodes.label: Structure injector or provider career paths explicitly (levels, compensation mil…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Structure injector or provider career paths explicitly (levels, compensation milestones, leadership tracks) to increase loyalty to the brand rather than to the individual practitioner.

_from why_most_med_spa_owners_stall_at_7m_wRe3Umk2hec.txt_

nodes.label: Pilot paid acquisition (PPC, paid social) before relying on organic-only growth …
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Pilot paid acquisition (PPC, paid social) before relying on organic-only growth in high-demand markets; organic demand is market-dependent and not a replicable system.

_from why_most_med_spa_owners_stall_at_7m_wRe3Umk2hec.txt_

nodes.label: Pivot away from large-footprint wellness center concepts toward smaller, higher-…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Pivot away from large-footprint wellness center concepts toward smaller, higher-ROI, tightly scoped locations (1,200–1,500 sq ft) focused on the highest-margin services, then replicate the model.

_from why_most_med_spa_owners_stall_at_7m_wRe3Umk2hec.txt_

nodes.label: Before pursuing top-of-funnel content or marketing expansion, fix the sales proc…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before pursuing top-of-funnel content or marketing expansion, fix the sales process first: if close rate is around 10% on warm referral leads, fixing the process likely triples revenue before any additional acquisition spend.

_from why_warren_buffett_calls_this_industry_a_scam_K9YN5sbwR94.txt_

nodes.label: For a center-of-influence-based business, rebuild all acquisition metrics around…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** For a center-of-influence-based business, rebuild all acquisition metrics around cost-per-acquired-affiliate (center of influence), not cost-per-acquired-end-client; orient all marketing messaging to attract and onboard referral partners.

_from why_warren_buffett_calls_this_industry_a_scam_K9YN5sbwR94.txt_

nodes.label: When launching a new affiliate partner, offer to do initial work for free in exc…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When launching a new affiliate partner, offer to do initial work for free in exchange for the right to use the affiliate's experience as a case study; alternatively, stipulate that the launch requires the affiliate to refer at least 10 clients so an internal proof set can be generated.

_from why_warren_buffett_calls_this_industry_a_scam_K9YN5sbwR94.txt_

nodes.label: To integrate an affiliate fully, identify where in their client onboarding workf…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To integrate an affiliate fully, identify where in their client onboarding workflow the referral can be embedded, so that every new client of the affiliate automatically enters your pipeline rather than only those the affiliate chooses to refer selectively.

_from why_warren_buffett_calls_this_industry_a_scam_K9YN5sbwR94.txt_

nodes.label: Give each affiliate partner a repeatable pitch formula they can include in their…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Give each affiliate partner a repeatable pitch formula they can include in their own sales process (e.g., a CPA can say: my clients also save X% on health benefits through our partner), because embedding the offer into the affiliate's pitch is more sustainable than relying on the affiliate to independently remember to refer clients.

_from why_warren_buffett_calls_this_industry_a_scam_K9YN5sbwR94.txt_

nodes.label: When pitching a value proposition that sounds too good to be true, anchor credib…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When pitching a value proposition that sounds too good to be true, anchor credibility by naming the industry average profit margin and showing structurally how your model eliminates it; this converts an unbelievable outcome claim into a believable structural explanation.

_from why_warren_buffett_calls_this_industry_a_scam_K9YN5sbwR94.txt_

nodes.label: Before consuming any piece of content — podcast, book, video — ask: what specifi…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before consuming any piece of content — podcast, book, video — ask: what specific behavior am I going to change as a result of this? If the answer is nothing, skip it or treat it explicitly as entertainment, not learning.

_from why_watching_podcasts_is_making_you_dumber_bpkxMfNiMbA.txt_

nodes.label: When trying to predict or influence another person's behavior, diagnose what the…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When trying to predict or influence another person's behavior, diagnose what they are deprived of relative to their reference group rather than asking how to motivate them. Deprivation identification yields stronger behavioral predictions than motivational framing.

_from why_watching_podcasts_is_making_you_dumber_bpkxMfNiMbA.txt_

nodes.label: Spend money wherever you can to learn more, and set up your life so that by defa…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Spend money wherever you can to learn more, and set up your life so that by default you are continuously increasing your knowledge exposure.

_from why_we_refused_to_join_the_100k_club_j7JGiFKooD4.txt_

nodes.label: When in a business partnership, read the same books, attend the same events, and…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When in a business partnership, read the same books, attend the same events, and share the cliff notes whenever one partner consumes content the other has not yet seen — so neither partner operates from an information asymmetry.

_from why_we_refused_to_join_the_100k_club_j7JGiFKooD4.txt_

nodes.label: Stop selling from your own wallet. If you come from a low-wealth background, you…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Stop selling from your own wallet. If you come from a low-wealth background, your intuitions about what prices are reasonable are calibrated to the wrong buyers. Assume the person across from you has money.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_

nodes.label: When creating an upsell tier, ensure it is 5–10x the price of the core offer and…
nodes.plugin: Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5–10x Gaps
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When creating an upsell tier, ensure it is 5–10x the price of the core offer and that you would be genuinely satisfied delivering it at that price. If delivery feels like too much work, either do less or charge more.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_

nodes.topic: Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5–10x Gaps

nodes.plugin: Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5–10x Gaps
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Expect only 1 in 5 to 1 in 10 prospects to say yes to a premium upsell. Optimizing for the most yeses is not the same as optimizing for the most money; premium offers require accepting a high no rate.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5–10x Gaps
nodes.topic: Pareto Pricing: Four-Tier Structure at 5–10x Gaps

nodes.label: If you are in person and literally cannot say a high price without choking, writ…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** If you are in person and literally cannot say a high price without choking, write it down and slide it to them, or show it on a calculator. Use physical distance between you and the number to reduce vocal hesitation.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_

nodes.label: Before stating a high price, say the words it’s super expensive. This pre-frames…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before stating a high price, say the words it’s super expensive. This pre-frames the anchor for wealthy buyers (who imagine a higher number) and pre-braces lower-budget buyers, while giving the salesperson a breath to compose themselves.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_

nodes.label: Check your close rate before assuming your price is correct or that sales skill …
nodes.plugin: Close Rate as Pricing Calibration Signal
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Check your close rate before assuming your price is correct or that sales skill is the problem. Apply Alex Hormozi’s rubric: above 60% signals underpricing, 30–40% signals appropriate pricing, below 30% signals a qualification or sales skill gap.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_
nodes.parent_id: concept:Close Rate as Pricing Calibration Signal
nodes.topic: Close Rate as Pricing Calibration Signal

nodes.description:
**Practice:** Start building a product line or advisory practice as high up the pricing ladder as you can operationally support, then add lower tiers over time. Do not start cheap and try to move premium; the brand narrative is much harder to reverse.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_

nodes.label: To qualify buyers for premium offers, signal in all marketing that you only serv…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To qualify buyers for premium offers, signal in all marketing that you only serve a specific type of high-budget customer. Let avatar clarity self-select the correct prospects before any sales conversation begins.

_from why_you_aren_t_making_as_much_money_as_you_want_ZuJryiwxjDw.txt_

nodes.label: Before pivoting to a new customer segment, spend at least one month running your…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Before pivoting to a new customer segment, spend at least one month running your acquisition system in that segment to collect enough LTV data to calculate a real LTV-to-CAC ratio.

_from why_you_can_t_run_two_businesses_at_once_3t6sA6OmzHA.txt_

nodes.label: When choosing between two different-avatar businesses, do not attempt to run bot…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When choosing between two different-avatar businesses, do not attempt to run both indefinitely; identify which has the better LTV-to-CAC ratio and sunset the weaker one.

_from why_you_can_t_run_two_businesses_at_once_3t6sA6OmzHA.txt_

nodes.label: When you are willing to give up the current smaller business (or the portion ser…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When you are willing to give up the current smaller business (or the portion serving a non-core avatar), treat that willingness as the entry condition for pursuing the higher-potential segment.

_from why_you_can_t_run_two_businesses_at_once_3t6sA6OmzHA.txt_

nodes.label: Avoid judging your own progress by the thoughts you have; track only the observa…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Avoid judging your own progress by the thoughts you have; track only the observable actions you take.

_from why_you_re_not_burnt_out_you_re_just_weak_85HElwKCAPY.txt_

nodes.label: When feeling burnt out, treat it as an athletic training signal — verify no inju…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When feeling burnt out, treat it as an athletic training signal — verify no injury is present, then increase rather than decrease volume to build adaptation.

_from why_you_re_not_burnt_out_you_re_just_weak_85HElwKCAPY.txt_

nodes.label: Train your sales team daily; a lack of daily training cadence is the primary exe…
nodes.plugin: Daily Sales Role-Play as Training Cadence
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Train your sales team daily; a lack of daily training cadence is the primary execution gap between businesses with high close rates and those that cannot replicate founder performance.

nodes.parent_id: concept:Daily Sales Role-Play as Training Cadence
nodes.topic: Daily Sales Role-Play as Training Cadence

nodes.description:
**Practice:** Audit your existing sales script and cut half or more of its length; scripts are typically too long and include product information the rep cannot credibly deliver, which is not required for the prospect to make a purchasing decision.

_from why_you_re_still_the_only_closer_in_your_business_fECT6E27oi8.txt_

nodes.label: Stop paying a rep commission on any sale that required your personal involvement…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Stop paying a rep commission on any sale that required your personal involvement to close; use commission withholding as the mechanism to break the habit of rep escalation to the founder.

_from why_you_re_still_the_only_closer_in_your_business_fECT6E27oi8.txt_

nodes.label: When launching a new business or product line, begin with the highest-price, low…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When launching a new business or product line, begin with the highest-price, lowest-volume tier you can credibly deliver; only expand to higher-volume, lower-price tiers after establishing brand equity and operational capacity.

_from why_you_should_always_build_a_business_top_down_Gr2A7wUoEwo.txt_

nodes.label: Avoid entering a market at the budget or mass-market tier if you intend to offer…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Avoid entering a market at the budget or mass-market tier if you intend to offer a premium product in the future; the low-price anchor is very difficult to overcome once set.

_from why_you_should_always_build_a_business_top_down_Gr2A7wUoEwo.txt_

nodes.label: If you are a service business without automation, move pricing in the opposite d…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** If you are a service business without automation, move pricing in the opposite direction of mass market: target the best customer at the highest possible price rather than competing for volume.

_from why_you_should_charge_5x_more_not_50_more_CTJRsVA89Oc.txt_

nodes.label: When adding a new pricing tier above your current core offer, make the jump at l…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When adding a new pricing tier above your current core offer, make the jump at least 5x, not 50%, because buyers evaluate tiers categorically, not incrementally.

_from why_you_should_charge_5x_more_not_50_more_CTJRsVA89Oc.txt_

nodes.label: Accept that only a small percentage of prospects will take a very high-price tie…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Accept that only a small percentage of prospects will take a very high-price tier, and be comfortable with that because even a small number at a high price is still significant revenue.

_from why_you_should_charge_5x_more_not_50_more_CTJRsVA89Oc.txt_

nodes.label: When a relationship partner or colleague asks you to change a behavior, first as…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When a relationship partner or colleague asks you to change a behavior, first ask whether changing that behavior costs you anything significant and whether keeping it benefits you more than the relationship benefit of changing it; if the cost is negligible and the benefit to them is real, change the behavior without treating it as an identity threat.

_from why_you_shouldn_t_put_your_actions_on_a_pedestal_70LSQk_RH_M.txt_

nodes.label: Extend your attribution window from 30-60 days to 6-12 months when evaluating br…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Extend your attribution window from 30-60 days to 6-12 months when evaluating brand-building ad spend to see its true return on capital.

_from why_your_10m_brand_will_never_hit_100m_x3Ft7uuSlKM.txt_

nodes.label: Shift thinking from quantitative performance-marketer mode (optimizing CTR, CPA,…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Shift thinking from quantitative performance-marketer mode (optimizing CTR, CPA, ROAS) to customer psychology mode (what associations does my target avatar find positive?) to execute brand building effectively.

_from why_your_10m_brand_will_never_hit_100m_x3Ft7uuSlKM.txt_

nodes.label: Identify the flagship brand or product line with the highest brand potential and…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Identify the flagship brand or product line with the highest brand potential and concentrate investment there before attempting to scale multiple undifferentiated product lines.

_from why_your_10m_brand_will_never_hit_100m_x3Ft7uuSlKM.txt_

nodes.label: Build founder story, narrative differentiation, and top-of-funnel awareness cont…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Build founder story, narrative differentiation, and top-of-funnel awareness content as the primary paid-media investment once the brand reaches a scale where direct-response-only spend begins compressing margins.

_from why_your_10m_brand_will_never_hit_100m_x3Ft7uuSlKM.txt_

nodes.label: To attract the right customers through content, stack all four SPCL components (…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** To attract the right customers through content, stack all four SPCL components (Status, Power, Credibility, Likeness) in your content strategy rather than optimizing for maximum view count or entertainment value.

nodes.description:
**Practice:** When building an influence-based content strategy, define your terms operationally (by what is observable with your eyes) rather than using emotionally loaded language, to make your advice more actionable and your audience's results more predictable.

_from why_your_content_isn_t_attracting_the_customers_you_want_2Abd02X4PnA.txt_

nodes.label: When creating content to build Power, make specific verifiable predictions or re…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** When creating content to build Power, make specific verifiable predictions or recommendations, allow your audience to act on them, and document the positive outcomes so each successful cycle compounds your future compliance rate.

_from why_your_content_isn_t_attracting_the_customers_you_want_2Abd02X4PnA.txt_

nodes.label: Build a grand opening playbook for each new restaurant location that specifies o…
nodes.description:
**Practice:** Build a grand opening playbook for each new restaurant location that specifies overstaffing levels, multi-channel ad spend, and promotional giveaway structure (mass promotions for casual concepts, exclusive invite-only for premium concepts).
